name: @neuropause/production
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 14 Enterprise Production, Reliability & Deployment Platform. The final operational layer that composes Waves 1-13 (unchanged) into a platform enterprises can deploy, operate, upgrade, secure, monitor, recover, and support in production: a production runtime + environment/deployment/release registries, an enterprise deployment manager (reusing Wave 7 cloud-ops), release management, zero-downtime upgrade strategies, a backup platform + disaster recovery (reusing cloud-ops backups), a high-availability platform (reusing cloud-ops fleet/kubernetes), observability (reusing operations), security hardening (reusing the cloud-ops secret vault + security sessions/keys), compliance verification, a performance platform (reusing operations performance), chaos engineering, health monitoring (reusing Wave 12 mission control), diagnostics, an upgrade assistant, an installer platform, enterprise documentation, a support platform, a production SDK, and governance. Production runtime/release/upgrade-planning/backup-registry/diagnostics/documentation/monitoring/SDK are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; external Kubernetes/Docker/AWS/Azure/GCP/VMware/Hyper-V/monitoring providers are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; production metrics/customer deployments/upgrade-and-incident history are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (never fabricated); and real HA clusters, multi-region failover, production DR, and global replication are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING — represented through validated descriptors until real environments exist. Every production operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id. No certification is claimed.
